fields.title: Welcome to Campuspulse Computer Scienctist
fields.body:
Hey everyone! Welcome to CampusPulse — this is now how we'll be handling attendance and staying in touch as a class.
A few quick things:
Check in only works when you're actually at the venue, so make sure your location is turned on
You'll get a notification the moment I start a session — no more missing check-ins
Announcements, assignments, and venue changes will all be posted right here from now on
You can track your own attendance rate and streak anytime from your dashboard
